content.short: The Hoskinsons is a collection of 10,000 NFTs acclaiming the contributions of 12 characters closely involved with he Cardano ecosystem.
content.description:
The Hoskinsons is a collection of unique, limited-edition NFT trading cards commemorating the Cardano platform while exploring and criticizing the sociocultural implications of technology, fanboyism, and the commodification of art through the lens of late twentieth-century popular culture. They are also Pretty To Look At™ and Fun To Trade.™

All 10,000 Hoskinsons have been released into the wild! Follow us on Twitter and stay tuned.

Missed out? Want to buy, sell, or trade? We’re live on jpg.store. Check out our discord marketplace and searchable community database.
